parameters.name: ResourceIds
parameters.description: The IDs of the resources. You can specify up to 20 IDs. Set this parameter to a JSON array.

parameters.name: ResourceRegionId
parameters.description: The region in which the resource resides.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description:
The type of the resource. Valid values:

*   **application**: Enterprise Distributed Application Service (EDAS) application
*   **cluster**: EDAS cluster

parameters.name: Tags
parameters.description:
The key-value pairs that specify the tags.

*   You can add up to 20 tags to a resource.
*   The key cannot start with **aliyun** or **acs:** and cannot contain **http://** or **https://**.
*   The tag key or tag value can be up to 128 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), commas (,), asterisks (\*), forward slashes (/), question marks (?), and colons (:).
*   Set this parameter to a JSON array.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun edas list-tag-resources --resource-type application --resource-ids 000e5836-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-0d6ab2ac4877 --tags key_:_key1_,_value_:_v1_,_key_:_key2_,_value_:_v2 --resource-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
